name: Ohann; Occupying the second orbit in a diagram of the Tatoo system
description: Ohann was the second planet orbiting the stars Tatoo I and Tatoo II in the Tatoo system. Located in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant. It was the largest out of the three planets in the Tatoo system.
lead_paragraphs: Ohann was the second planet orbiting the stars Tatoo I and Tatoo II in the Tatoo system. Located in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant. It was the largest out of the three planets in the Tatoo system.
Drone barges were used to ferry ice blocks from Ohann's ice rings. The free-trader Garouf Lafoe imported ice from Adriana's rings to Tatooine.
